guardian.title: AI Guardian
guardian.emptyHint: Ask me anything about staying safe in Georgia — a neighborhood, a situation, what to do next.
guardian.error: Guardian couldn't respond. Check your connection and try again.
guardian.newChatBody: This conversation will be deleted from your phone. It's kept for one day otherwise.
guardian.intro: I know where you are and what's around you, so you can just ask normally. I can tell you if an area is safe right now, plan your day, warn you about common scams, help with taxis and prices, or find a pharmacy, ATM or hospital nearby. Nothing you write here is shared with anyone.
guardian.starter1: Is it safe to walk here right now?
guardian.starter3: What should I watch out for in Georgia?
guardian.starter4: How much should a taxi cost from here?

premium.headlineGeneral: Unlock the assistant and place contributions.
premium.featureGuardian: Unlimited AI assistant — it knows where you are

premium.stillFree: The safety layer stays free — always: zones, landmarks, pharmacies, ATMs, hospitals and police on the map, plus SOS, 112, embassies, scam warnings and taxi prices.
premium.unavailable: Purchases aren't available right now. Check your connection and try again.
premium.failedBody: Nothing was charged. Please try again.
premium.legal: Payment is charged to your App Store account when you confirm the purchase. The 5-day and 10-day passes are one-time purchases: they end on their own and do not renew.
premium.autoRenewInfo: The monthly plan renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your App Store account settings.
premium.limitTitle: Your {n} free questions are used up
